entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'd like to start a return for a jersey I bought a few weeks ago.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference thing. I ordered it in my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. The fit is just too tight across the chest.

I understand completely, getting the perfect fit is important. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see you received the jersey 23 days ago. That's no problem at all, you're well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, great. So what's the next step? I'd like to do an exchange for a larger size if possible.

Absolutely. I've just processed the exchange request. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid return label. Just send the original jersey back to us, and once it's in transit, we'll ship out the new size to you.

That sounds easy enough. Thank you. Since I'm having to go through the process of sending this back and waiting for the new one, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? Just as a gesture of goodwill.

I appreciate you asking. While our policy for a size exchange doesn't include a promotional credit, I can confirm that the shipping for both the return and the new item is completely covered by VeloFit. There won't be any extra cost to you.
Okay, that's fair. Free shipping both ways works for me. I appreciate you clarifying that. Thanks for making the exchange so straightforward.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
